summary: One row per vote. A person's own vote is found through created_by, so the tally cannot be forged by editing a text cell.

props.name: Choice
props.note: Rename and extend these to the real options with prop_update before anyone votes.

notes: One vote per person is a page convenience, not enforcement: anyone can still add a row in a table view. Say so in the reply.
Authorship comes from created_by only. Never add a writable 'Voter' text or person column: it can be forged.
The title column holds the voter's display name for readability; the tally never trusts it.
